plugin.name: MSP_Lua
plugin.author: Nick Gammon
plugin.description:
Type: "msp:help" to see this help.
See: http://www.gammon.com.au/forum/bbshowpost.php?bbsubject_id=783 for a more complete description.
You will need to get the sound files manually (ie. from the MUD) and install them before using this. The plugin is configured to look for them in the "sounds" directory of the MUSHclient installation, but you can change that by typing:
set_msp_path new_path
eg.
set_msp_path d:\muds\mushclient\msp

muclient.script:
function fSound (filename) PlaySound (0, GetVariable ("msp_path") .. filename) return "" -- omit MSP stuff from output end -- function fSound
-- handle a line with !!SOUND in it function OnSound (name, line, wildcards, styles)
-- echo existing line with colours, sending !!SOUND part to a function for _, v in ipairs (styles) do local text = string.gsub (v.text, "!!SOUND%(([%a%d./]+).-%)", fSound) ColourTell (RGBColourToName (v.textcolour), RGBColourToName (v.backcolour), text) end -- for each style run
Note ("") -- finish the line end -- function OnSound
-- change desired sound file path function On_set_MSP_path (name, line, wildcards) local path = wildcards [1]
-- ensure trailing backslash if string.sub (path, -1) ~= "\\" then path = path .. "\\" end -- if
SetVariable ("msp_path", path) print ("MSP sound files will be obtained from " .. path) end -- function On_set_MSP_path
-- do telnet negotiation function OnPluginTelnetRequest (type, data) if type == 90 and data == "WILL" then return true -- IAC DO MSP else return false end -- if end -- function OnPluginTelnetRequest
-- show help function OnHelp () print (GetPluginInfo (GetPluginID (), 3)) end -- function OnHelp
-- use supplied path or default msp_path = GetVariable ("msp_path") or GetInfo (74)
